paragraphs: The Discovery HSE is a trim level rather than a distinct engine variant — it can carry several different engines across the D3 and D4 generations. From 2004 to 2016, a Discovery HSE could have a TDV6, SDV6, Si6, TDV8, or SDV8 depending on specification and model year. The HSE badge indicates the top-spec trim, not a specific engine code, which is why matching your exact engine by registration is essential before any work is quoted or carried out. The Discovery 4 (D4) facelift was produced from 2009 to 2016, and the HSE trim was available with the same range of engines across both generations. Land Rover Discovery HSE Engine Codes Since HSE is a trim badge, the engine fitted depends entirely on the specific vehicle specification. The TDV6, SDV6, Si6, TDV8 and SDV8 are all possible — each with its own characteristics and components. We confirm your exact engine code before quoting any work. The HSE is a trim level, not a specific engine. Discovery HSE models from the D3 and D4 generations (2004–2016) can have TDV6, SDV6, Si6, TDV8 or SDV8 engines. Enter your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has. How much does a Land Rover Discovery HSE engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,400 for the V6 engines (TDV6, SDV6, Si6) and from £4,500 for the V8 diesels (TDV8, SDV8). Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery HSE? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV6, SDV6, Si6, TDV8 or SDV8 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild TDV6 and SDV6 Discovery HSE engines? Yes — these are our most common Discovery HSE rebuilds. Timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk are all addressed as standard. Do you rebuild TDV8 and SDV8 Discovery HSE engines? Yes — these V8 diesels share the same timing chain and injector pattern as the TDV6/SDV6 family and are serviced to the same high standard. Do you supply used Discovery HSE engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Discovery HSE if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Discovery HSE engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Discovery HSE owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.codeHighlight: TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6
cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Discovery HSE from 2023 to present. The TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 rebuild.
